articleTitle: Compact photonic crystal Si-LN modulator realized by micro-transfer printing
abstract: High-density heterogeneous integration of thin-film lithium niobate is in demand for realizing compact silicon circuitry equipped with Pockels moduators. A very compact photonic crystal modulator is demonstrated. The Si-LN photonic crystal cavity shows an insertion loss of -2.6dB and an extinction ratio of >30dB. The modulator shows a tuning efficiency of 6.23 pm/V and electro-optical modulation bandwidth of 3.5GHz.

articleTitle: K-clock interferometer-integrated Si photonics SLG FMCW LiDAR
abstract: In Si photonics slow-light grating LiDAR chip, 24 cm Si waveguide interferometer was integrated for k-clock sampling. 3D point cloud images were acquired by repeating the beam scanning and ranging via direct laser modulation.

articleTitle: Digital Infrastructure Pivots on Silicon Photonics: An Aspect from the Past, Present, and Future of Optical Communications
abstract: This plenary talk will address that the era of photonics-electronics convergence is beginning from the historical viewpoint of optical communication. It will then describe the activities of AIST, aiming at the realization of the future digital infrastructure which involves the convergence of computing and networking.

articleTitle: Extended InGaAs photodiode integrated on SOI waveguide circuit for 2 µm waveband
abstract: We demonstrate micro transfer printing of 2 µm bandgap photodiodes onto an SOI circuit. The integrated photodiode has a dark current below 15 nA and responsivity-0.45 A/W at a reverse bias voltage of 2 V.

articleTitle: Purcell-Enhanced Light Emission from the Zero-Phonon Line and the Phonon Sideband of W Centers in Silicon Microcavities
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate resonant enhancement of W center emission from both the zero-phonon line and the phonon-assisted sideband in silicon microcavities, opening new possibilities for efficient light emitters.

articleTitle: Reversible and Non-Volatile Optical Phase Shift in Silicon Nitride Waveguide
abstract: We demonstrated a reversible and non-volatile optical phase shift in a silicon nitride waveguide by an alternating process sequence of annealing and ultraviolet irradiation. A phase shift of 0.268π was observed in an asymmetric Mach-Zehnder interferometer with a 400-μm-long phase shifter.

articleTitle: Silicon broadband metalens with wide field of view for optical beam steering in free space
abstract: We report on a broadband and wide field of view metalens design based on a quadratic phase profile. Exploiting meta-atoms dispersion, the metalens focal length shows a negligible dependence on wavelength throughout the 1500 - 1600 nm wavelength range and a 60° field of view in air.

articleTitle: Wavelength-insensitive and Lossless 50:50 Directional Coupler Based on Silicon Bent Waveguides
abstract: A broadband 50:50 bent directional coupler, based on low loss bends, is experimentally demonstrated to significantly reduce coupling variation from 0.369 in the traditional directional coupler to just 0.076 over an 80 nm wavelength range, showcasing a substantial 4.85 times less coupling variation.

articleTitle: A Compact and High-Q value SiN Microring Resonator for Microwave Photonic Applications
abstract: We have explored compact design of microring resonator in SiN platform for a demonstration of widely tunable narrow-bandpass microwave photonic filter and optoelectronic oscillator. Higher Q value (> 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>) and wider FSR (> 100 GHz) of a microring resonator are the essential figure of merits for such applications.

articleTitle: Stimulated Emission from Hexagonal Silicon-Germanium Nanowires
abstract: We investigated single hexagonal silicon -germanium nanowires using photoluminescence spectroscopy. We observe stimulated emission at a threshold at 0.2 mJcm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>, with a net optical gain at -294 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> below the gain threshold. This puts hex-SiGe close to lasing, opening the path to a silicon-based nanolaser.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive Tunable Silicon Photonic Optical Filters for Data Center Transceivers
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization-independent tunable silicon photonic integrated optical filter for high-speed optical transceivers. The device utilizes Polarization Splitter-Rotators (PSRs) and Vernier Microring Resonators (MRRs). The filter is configured and thermally tuned continuously across the C-band, within a feasible maximum temperature change of (70-80) K.

articleTitle: 430nm optical transceiver on CMOS using 304 μLEDs with aggregate 1 Tbps and sub-pJ per bit capability
abstract: 1Tbps 16nm-CMOS transceiver IC with microLED array-based transmitter and hybrid silicon detector array runs at about 1pJ/bit using 304 channels at 3.3Gbps per lane. Initial results are shown for single lane and in various configurations.

articleTitle: AGF-based optimization for wideband flat directional coupling and microring resonating
abstract: In this work, we presented directional couplers with wideband flat coupling-ratio and a microring resonator with wideband uniform extinction-ratio (ER) based on artificial-gaugefield optimization. Proof-of-concept results are obtained on SOI and SiN platforms, with 0.9dB coupling-ratio variation and 1.6dB ER variation over 100nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Beam shaping based on a silicon optical phased array chip
abstract: In this study, we present a method for free-space beam shaping and steering based on a silicon optical phased array, which addresses the theoretical limitation of traditional bulk optics. We theoretically analyze the beam propagation properties with changes in the applied phase. Different beam profiles can be shaped by varying the phase combination, while a high-order quasi-Bessel beam can be generated with a cubic change to the phase modulation. The simulated results are validated further experimentally, and they match one another well. The presented method is expected to have broad application prospects for optical communications, free-space optical interconnects, and light detection and ranging.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable optical delay line breaking the bandwidth-delay limit
abstract: We propose a continuously tunable true-time delay line with easy coupler control. It is based on multiple Mach-Zehnder interferometers with two couplers setting. One setting achieves a flat-top group delay spectra, breaking the bandwidthdelay limit, while the other offers a large transmission bandwidth.

articleTitle: Controlled spectral enhancement in supercontinuum generation by quasi-phase matching Si3N4 waveguide
abstract: Supercontinuum generation (SCG) is the main way to build broadband light sources. Quasi-phase-matching (QPM) offers SCG more flexibility, but faces power and fabrication challenges. This study uses a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> waveguide to achieve efficient QPM-SCG with lower power demands and tailored spectral bandwidth, advancing power-efficient customizable broadband sources.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Optical Transceiver Circuits Enabled by 3D Heterogeneous Integration
abstract: An optical transceiver architecture based on 12nm FinFET front-end circuits that are co-designed with silicon photonic microdisk modulators and drop filters achieves sub-500fJ/b operation at 18Gb/s. The optical transmitter utilizes a low-power quarter-rate architecture, while the receiver employs a variable-bandwidth transimpedance amplifier for improved sensitivity.

articleTitle: Frequency Comb-based High-Speed Data Transmission with Integrated Tunable Dispersion Compensation
abstract: Frequency comb-based high-speed data transmission is limited in data rate and reach due to dispersion impairments. We demonstrate an integrated SiN platform for frequency comb generation and tunable dispersion compensation, enabling 50Gb/s line rates over 20km of optical fiber and >14dB improvement in the TDECQ.

articleTitle: Optimized polarization insensitive grating antenna in the SOI platform
abstract: We report on an optimized polarization-insensitive grating design based on subwavelength metamaterials and L-shaped structures in a 500 nm silicon on insulator platform. The grating achieves the same scattering angle of 10° with similar efficiency for TE and TM modes based on 3D FDTD simulations.

articleTitle: Broadband and efficient polarization splitter-rotator in the silicon nitride platform for the 0.95 μm wavelength band
abstract: We present the experimental demonstration of a polarization splitter-rotator on a silicon nitride platform for wavelengths around 0.95 µm. The device exhibits polarization extinction ratios exceeding 40 dB and 30 dB for TE and TM polarizations, respectively and insertions losses lower than 1 dB.

articleTitle: Power-efficient 2 × 2 Si Mach-Zehnder interferometer optical switch utilizing compact slow-light phase shifter
abstract: A novel Si Mach-Zehnder interferometer optical switch is numerically studied. Through utilizing the photonic crystal waveguide in the perturbed kagome lattice with a high group index, a compact phase shifter of 17.7 μm is designed, and a low switching power of 305 μW is confirmed.

articleTitle: Photonic Cryptographic Circuits Consisting of Thermo-optic MZI Switch or Y-Branches
abstract: This paper demonstrates a silicon-photonics-based cryptographic circuit for a block cipher. The cipher is based on the one-hot encoding method utilizing thermo-optic MZI switches or Y-branches. The correct output can be calculated with a low latency of approximately 47 ps or 201 ps.

articleTitle: Cladding Modulated Distributed Bragg Filters in Single Mode Silicon Nitride Waveguide
abstract: We report experimental demonstration of high performance DBR filters (operating in C-band) in SiN waveguides by cladding integrated grating structures. The gap between waveguide core and grating structure is shown to be an additional key parameter for the fine control of the DBR filter characteristics.

articleTitle: Scaling Silicon Photonics-based Laser Doppler Vibrometry with Multi-Beam Frequency Shifters
abstract: We introduce a multi-beam frequency shifter to enable a scalable architecture for silicon photonics-based Laser Doppler Vibrometers with multiple beams. We show its impact in reducing the amount of electrical connections for high beamcount LDVs on the silicon photonics platform compared to conventional multi-beam architectures.

articleTitle: Direct-Drive 224 Gbps/λ PAM4 and 112 Gbps/λ NRZ Silicon Photonic Transmitter Enabled by FOWLP Electronic-Photonic Integration
abstract: The feasibility of direct-drive, where the drivers are integrated in the (Switch) ASIC Serdes, is successfully demonstrated for both 112 GBaud NRZ and PAM4 (224 Gbps/λ) on a silicon photonic transmitter fabricated using FOWLP. Excellent TDEC and TDECQ performance was achieved even with conservative equalization.

articleTitle: High power >1.5W tunable laser based on CMOS compatible high-power amplifier
abstract: We demonstrate a widely tunable laser amplified to high power with a CMOS-compatible integrated LMA power amplifier. We show amplified power up to 1.5 W from around 100 mW of input seed power in the wavelength window spanning from 1800 to 1900 nm.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of a Fully Integrated Hybrid External Cavity Laser in Edge-Coupling Configuration via µTransfer-Printing
abstract: We present the first demonstration of a fully integrated hybrid external cavity laser (HECL) in edge-coupling configuration by means of micro-transfer printing. The HECL is able to achieve single-mode regime over a wide range of driving currents with SMSR in the range of 40 dB.

articleTitle: Membrane InGaAsP-bulk Photodetector Using Franz-Keldysh Effect for Wide Bandwidth and High Responsivity
abstract: We demonstrate an over-67-GHz-bandwidth O-band membrane photodetector (PD) with an InGaAsP-bulk core on a Si photonics platform. The membrane PD has a fiber-to-PD responsivity of 0.6 A/W. Clear eye opening is achieved for 100-Gbit/s non-return-to-zero signal.

articleTitle: High-efficiency single-etch grating coupler on a hybrid α-Si/SiN photonic platform
abstract: We present the design of a high-efficiency silicon nitride grating coupler with an amorphous silicon overlay. The device combines subwavelength engineering with phase apodization. We anticipate a peak coupling efficiency of -1.2 dB and a 1-dB bandwidth of 30 nm centered at 1310 nm.

articleTitle: Escalator Interconnects for Massively Multi-Layer Integrated Photonic Systems
abstract: We demonstrate the fabrication of four-layer escalator interconnects using sputtered metal oxide alloys for the purpose of multi-layer routing of optical power. Broad bandwidth interlayer couplers with losses as low as 1 dB/transition are reported.

articleTitle: Programmable Line-by-Line Pulse Shaping with a Microresonator-Based Spectral Shaper
abstract: We describe a method for programming microresonator-based integrated photonic spectral pulse shapers and implement it experimentally on a 6-channel silicon photonic device with narrow linewidth resonators to compress lines from a 3 GHz electro-optic comb.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband, Fabrication-tolerant 3-dB Power Splitter Based on Dual-layer SOI Platform
abstract: A 3-dB adiabatic directional coupler based on dual-layer SOI is innovatively proposed. Our proposed device offers an ultra-broadband of 300 nm and compact footprint of 65 μm, with a 0.19 dB loss. With its comprehensive performance, it can be used in large-scale photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Carrier-suppressed Silicon IQ Modulator at 75 Gbaud
abstract: A small footprint silicon photonic (SiPh) carrier-suppressed IQ modulator is realized using a 3-arm structure. The tunable carrier allows for coherent detection and Kramers-Kronig (KK) detection to be integrated for multi-lane compact coherent transceivers.

articleTitle: Light Monitoring in Standard Silicon Photonics with a Monolithic Transimpedance Amplifier
abstract: The integration of a transimpedance amplifier in standard Silicon Photonics is presented. The circuit can successfully read integrated photodiodes up to a frequency of 2 MHz and down to −40 dBm of input optical power, demonstrating successful on-chip analog processing of electrical signals.

articleTitle: High-Speed Low-Voltage MOSCAP-Driven Silicon Microring Modulator
abstract: We demonstrated a highly efficient silicon microring modulator integrated with high-mobility titanium-doped indium oxide/hafnium oxide/silicon MOSCAP. It achieved a low V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf>•L of 0.12 V•cm and low driving voltage (Vpp) of 0.8V, resulting in 25 Gb/s open eye with 53 fJ/bit energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Utilizing Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) for Flexible Data Rate Allocation in Integrated Mode Division Multiplexing (MDM) Optical Power Divider
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a silicon-photonics (SiPh) mode-division-multiplexing (MDM) optical-power-divider. By utilizing non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA), flexible data rate allocation to multiple users can be achieved for system-on-chip.

articleTitle: On-Chip Monolithic Integration of QD Lasers Coupled to Foundry-Processed SiN Waveguides on 300 mm SOI Wafer
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time on-chip monolithic integration of quantum-dot (QD) lasers coupled to foundry-processed SiN waveguides on 300 mm SOI wafer with direct in-pocket MBE growth and etched-facet mirrors. This enables scalable prodcution of next-generation on-chip light sources for Si photonics.

articleTitle: 2-μm-long VO2/Si device with multilevel-memory response
abstract: A hybrid vanadium dioxide/silicon (VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si) device with multilevel volatile-memory operation is demonstrated by exploiting the VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> phase transition hysteresis. The device can reach up to 32 levels with an ultra-compact length and insertion losses of 2.5 dB.

articleTitle: Deep learning-driven phase calibration methodology for enhanced beamforming in integrated optical phased array
abstract: We introduce a novel approach leveraging a deep neural network architecture for precise phase calibration in a 64-channel integrated optical phased array. Experimental results demonstrate its high predictive accuracy and phase calibration performance, which are comparable to conventional optimization-based algorithms across the multiple beam directions.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of various-type III-V epitaxial structures on silicon-photonics platform using chip-on-wafer hydrophilic bonding process
abstract: Direct bonding of InP active regions on a Si waveguide circuit is demonstrated using chip-on-wafer hydrophilic bonding process, and PL spectra from different epitaxial structures are verified. Using this process, the stable operation of hybrid lasers is obtained after an aging test over 2500 hours.

articleTitle: Polarization-Insensitive High-Speed All-Silicon Double-Microring Avalanche Photodiodes
abstract: We demonstrate a novel polarization-insensitive high-performance all-silicon double-microring avalanche photodiode with two-dimensional grating coupler, exhibiting peak responsivity of ~1 A/W, low dark current of ~ 1.5 nA, high bandwidth of 40 GHz and data rate of 144 Gb/s for both orthogonal light polarizations.

articleTitle: High Q-factor (>105) integrated resonators in the 7.5-9 µm wavelength range
abstract: Photonic integrated circuits in the mid-infrared wavelength range are undergoing rising development due to major applications in terms of sensing and environmental monitoring. In this context, we present the development of integrated resonators operating in the long wave infra-red spectral range, which are critical building blocks for many devices development. Challenges in terms of device design, fabrication and characterization in this spectral range will be discussed. As a main result, integrated resonators with Q factor higher than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> have been obtained using Ge-rich graded SiGe photonics circuits.

articleTitle: Heterogeneously Integrated Passively Mode-Locked Quantum Dot Laser on Silicon
abstract: This paper presents a quantum dot mode-locked laser platform heterogeneously integrated with low-loss Si waveguides and Si photonics devices. Such devices promise great advancements for high-performance computing, high-bandwidth communications, and precision spectroscopy in next generation PICs.

articleTitle: Channel Phase-Error Initialization via Inverse Designed On-Chip Silicon Metalens
abstract: We propose a method for phase initialization and error correction using silicon on-chip metalens. Leveraging inverse design techniques, we engineered on-chip metalens with high-performance characteristics of 61.3% focusing efficiency and 0.39 numerical aperture at 1550 nm wavelength, with a broad operation bandwidth of 380 nm.

articleTitle: 53 Gbps Optical Link with Co-designed DSP and Integrated EAM Driver, Heterogeneously-Integrated Transmitter, and Monolithically-Integrated Receiver
abstract: We demonstrate an optical link at 53 Gbps using a 53G DSP with integrated electroabsorption modulator driver, a transmitter with heterogeneously integrated tunable lasers and electroabsorption modulators, and a receiver with monolithically integrated photodetectors and transimpedance amplifiers.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Detectivity of Direct Bandgap Ge0.86Sn0.14 Photodiodes by Layer Transfer
abstract: Direct bandgap Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.86</inf>Sn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.14</inf> photodiodes were fabricated on Si substrates using layer transfer. The layer transfer did not degrade the noise of the initial photodiode stacks, while the underlying metallic mirrors improved the responsivity at 300 K by a factor of 2.9 at 2.5 µm.

articleTitle: A 112-Gb/s Hybrid-Integrated Si Photonic WDM Receiver with Ring-Resonator Filters
abstract: We present a hybrid-integrated Si photonic WDM receiver consisting of a photonic IC containing four ring resonator WDM filters with photodetectors and an electronic IC containing four transimpedance amplifiers. The ring resonators are thermally controlled by FPGA for stable 4λ × 28-Gb/s receiver operation.

articleTitle: Global optimization of universal unitary photonic integrated circuits
abstract: Universal unitary photonic integrated circuits (PICs) can have widespread applications in optical communication, deep learning, and quantum information processing, due to their ability to perform arbitrary unitary transformations in the optical domain. While large-scale universal unitary PICs have been demonstrated, their performances are fundamentally sensitive to fabrication errors. In this work, we propose a method to compensate for the errors by adding extra MZI stages and globally optimizing all the phase shifts using a simulated annealing algorithm. Furthermore, we experimentally demonstrate its feasibility using a 4×4 universal unitary PIC fabricated on a Si-on-insulator (SOI) platform.

articleTitle: Low breakdown voltage and high speed Avalanche Photodiode Based on SOI substrate
abstract: A novel lateral avalanche photodiode (APD) is presented. By taking advantage of Silicon-On-Insulator (SOI) substrate combined with separation absorption multiplier(SAM) structure, the demonstrated APDs exhibit wide bandwidth (13.2 GHz) and high gain (148). Furthermore, the minimum breakdown voltage of the measured device is 6.1V.

articleTitle: OFDR characterization of silicon wavelength (de)multiplexer based on cascaded MZIs and apodized waveguide gratings
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon wavelength (de)multiplexer by combining low-loss (-0.69 dB) cascaded MZIs and low-interface-reflection (-25 dB) grating-based optical bandpass filters. The analysis of such complicated optical circuit is conducted by optical frequency-domain reflectometry.

articleTitle: Large and Complete Topological Bandgaps with Edge modes in Symmetric SOI Photonic Crystal Slabs
abstract: We successfully fabricated symmetric silicon-on-insulator photonic crystal slabs that materialized wide topological bandgaps and edge modes for the lowest-order symmetric TE (transverse electric)-like modes. We confirmed their complete bandgaps by high-angle-resolution reflection measurements and polarization selection rules, and detected the presence of edge modes.

articleTitle: Wavelength division multiplexer base on modal-engineered Bragg filters in silicon
abstract: Wavelength division multiplexers are key devices for applications in communications and quantum processing. Here, we show a modal-engineered Bragg filter and directional coupler that provide low loss selection of 5 nm band near 1550 nm wavelength, exploiting apodization to yield 20 dB side-lobe suppression.

articleTitle: Temperature-insensitive Mach-Zehnder interferometer filters based on silicon nitride waveguides
abstract: We demonstrated a Mach-Zehnder interferometer filter with a 20 nm free spectral range in the C-band. By optimizi ng the arm widths, we reduced temperature-induced wavelength sensitivity from 16 to just 0.5 m/°C, improving device stability.

articleTitle: Investigation of Q degradation in low-loss Si3N4 from heterogeneous laser integration
abstract: Qs above 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> have been demonstrated in CMOS-foundry-fabricated microresonators, but preserving the low loss during heterogeneous integration of III-V lasers has proven difficult. Here, Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> resonator Qs are measured between laser backend processing steps, showing loss increases from certain steps and low-loss restoration after annealing.

articleTitle: Miniaturized Optical Power Splitter with Arbitrary Output Modes Using Inverse Design and Active Phase Shifters
abstract: We propose an on-chip optical-power-splitter on silicon-on-insulator (SOI) platform utilizing thermo-optic phase-shifters and inverse-design. The design consists of MMIs, phase-shifters and an inverse-design Y-junction. The results indicate that optical power splitting can be achieved in arbitrary mode states of TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>, TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, and TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> modes.

articleTitle: Brillouin Scattering in Subwavelength Silicon Waveguides
abstract: Brillouin scattering has great potential for communications and quantum technology applications. Here, we propose a novel subwavelength waveguide design to achieve narrow linewidth and strong optomechanical interaction. A Stokes gain of 1.5dB is experimentally achieved in a 6mm-length waveguide with 35.5 mW of input power.

articleTitle: Beyond 300Gb/s from an integrated single-channel silicon photonics modulator driver combination
abstract: We investigate the performance boundary of integrated CMOS silicon photonics transmitters by using optical equalisation techniques. Without using any off-line DSP techniques at the receiver side, experimental results demonstrate 182Gbps OOK and 308Gbps PAM-4 transmissions with the energy efficiency including driver, of better than 1pJ/bit.

articleTitle: PAM4 Signal Regenerator using Mach-Zehnder Interferometer based Optical Neural Network (ONN)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate by simulation a silicon-photonics (SiPh) based optical-neural-network (ONN) for 4-level-pulse-amplitude-modulation (PAM4) signal regeneration. The 40-GBaud/s PAM4 signal at 1550 nm can satisfy soft-decision-forward-error-correction (SD-FEC) (i.e. bit-error-rate, BER < 2.4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>) after 12 km standard-single-mode-fiber (SSMF) transmission with the proposed ONN.

articleTitle: Direct Bandgap Type I Hexagonal Germanium/Silicon-Germanium Quantum Wells
abstract: We have investigated hexagonal Germanium/Silicon-Germanium nanowire quantum well heterostructures using photoluminescence. Bright light emission and varying quantum confinement with well thickness are observed which are characteristics indicative of a direct bandgap Type I nature of the hex-Ge/SiGe QW system.

articleTitle: Toward all-MOCVD grown InAs/GaAs quantum dot laser diode on a Si substrate for O-band telecommunication
abstract: In this paper, we will present the results of the InAs/GaAs quantum dot laser diode (QDLD) utilizing MOCVD system. GaAs/Si template has only 1.5 × 107 cm-2 of threading dislocation density and the QDLD on GaAs substrate shows continuous-wave operation characteristics up to 75 °C.

articleTitle: High Efficiency Polarization-Diversity Two-dimensional Waveguide Grating Coupler for Perfectly Vertical Coupling
abstract: We propose a novel high performance dual polarization waveguide grating coupler that can be fabricated by deep UV photolithography for perfectly vertical coupling to standard single mode fiber with high efficiency and low polarization dependent loss.

articleTitle: Coupling structure for enabling both wafer- and chip-level characterization of silicon photonic integrated circuits
abstract: We propose a coupling structure that combines both grating couplers and spot-size converters for characterization of silicon photonic integrated circuits. The structure is expected to reduce testing costs by utilizing wafer-level testing to estimate the characteristics of final chip-level devices.

articleTitle: Zero-Change Zero-Cost Electronics in Silicon Photonics for Real-Time Control of Programmable Interferometric Meshes
abstract: We present the integration of electronic circuits into a standard photonic platform, without modifications to the technological stack and therefore at zero added cost. Electronic integrated multiplexers are successfully demonstrated to drastically reduce the number of interconnections to feedback control large-scale programmable photonic circuits.

articleTitle: High performance silicon photonics filters for quantum applications
abstract: Integrated optical filters are key building blocks in many applications including quantum optics, microwave photonics and telecommunications. Bragg grating structures stand out as a prominent solution for filtering in silicon chips because of their virtually infinite free-spectral range, high rejection ratios and narrow bandwidths. In this presentation we summarize two of our recent contributions in integrated Bragg filters including: i) a contra-directional coupler for quantum applications with a 40 dB rejection of the pump wavelength for both polarizations, and ii) a thermally tunable notch filter with controllable sidelobes. Both devices introduce new design approaches for optical systems demanding high performance spectral filtering.

articleTitle: Achromatic subwavelength-assisted power splitter for next-generation silicon photonics
abstract: On-chip power splitters are fundamental building blocks in photonic integrated circuits. In this work, we use subwavelength metamaterials to engineer a 3-dB Y-junction power splitter exhibiting ultra-low excess loss of less than 0.3 dB over an unprecedented bandwidth of 700 nm (1300 – 2000 nm).

articleTitle: High-speed Electro-absorption Modulator Assisted by Iron Doping for Micro-Transfer-Printing Integration
abstract: A high-speed lumped-element electro-absorption modulator designed for micro-transfer-printing onto silicon has been tested. The modulators use an iron doped layer to reduce the parasitic capacitance of the devices after transfer-printing, which is beneficial for achieving high bandwidth for heterogeneous integration applications with silicon photonics.

articleTitle: Photonic Integrated Circuit Assisted Photothermal Spectroscopy
abstract: For the first time, we demonstrate on-chip photothermal spectroscopy of a liquid phase sample, namely water in isopropanol and will show how this technique can be used to realize compact highly sensitive and selective sensors for a range of analytes.

articleTitle: Coherent Ising machines on photonic integrated circuits
abstract: Ising machines offer high computational capabilities as next-generation hardware accelerators for combinatorial optimization problems. Here, we present numerical simulations of coherent Ising machines (CIMs) in silicon photonics, having a fifth-order nonlinearity operated in the large-noise regime. They show competitive scalability compared to other state-of-the-art CIMs.

articleTitle: TCO/Si arrayed modulator device with expanded response in the complex plane
abstract: Transparent conducting oxides (TCOs) demonstrate promise for CMOS-compatible amplitude and phase modulators. However, single capacitors pose limitations on the independent modulation of real and imaginary permittivity, constraining modulation capabilities in the complex plane. To overcome this bottleneck, a multi-length array of TCO-heterojunction capacitors is introduced.

articleTitle: A Silicon Photonic Universal Cellular Automaton
abstract: Herein, we demonstrate the first silicon photonic cellular automaton. Results were measured using p-n junction microring resonators on a silicon photonic platform. Demonstrated are the rules 90, 250 and 110 cellular automata, signifying that this computing system is Turing complete and can compute any program.

articleTitle: Design of sub-decibel-loss and fabrication-tolerant silicon photonic bi-layer grating couplers
abstract: A strategy for the design and optimization of bi-layer grating couplers is presented and applied to a 220 nm thick silicon photonic platform. Coupling efficiency values exceeding –0.3 dB are numerically demonstrated with either the use of an amorphous silicon or germanium overlay.

articleTitle: DAC- and DSP-Free Optical Transmitter Based on Triple-Parallel Si Mach-Zehnder Modulators
abstract: Triple-parallel Si Mach-Zehnder modulators can be used for PAM generation, pre-distortion, and pre-emphasis without using a DSP and electrical DAC. It reduces the total power consumption of the optical transmitter to 1/3.

articleTitle: High-speed silicon photonic modulators for coherent optical transmission
abstract: Using novel photonic structures such as segmented traveling-wave phase shifters and microring-assisted Mach-Zehnder interferometers, high-bandwidth silicon photonic modulators have been proven to be capable of supporting Tb/s coherent optical transmission with an ultra-high bandwidth density.

articleTitle: SOA Integrated InP/Si Hybrid Tunable Laser by Utilizing Chip-on-Wafer Hydrophilic Bonding
abstract: The SOA integrated InP/Si hybrid tunable laser is demonstrated. Each gain sections for the laser and SOA is monolithically integrated on the Si waveguide by chip-on-wafer hydrophilic bonding. The maximum light output power of 26 mW is achieved thanks to the integrated SOA.

articleTitle: Bandwidth enhancement in GeSn-on-Si avalanche photodiodes with a 60 GHz gain-bandwidth-product
abstract: We report GeSn-on-Si avalanche photodiodes with a Sn concentration of 2.1 %. The devices exhibit a bandwidth enhancement at high reverse voltages achieving bandwidths up to 3.9 GHz and high gains at 1,550 nm, resulting in a 60 GHz gain-bandwidth-product.

articleTitle: Transfer Printed InP-based Membrane Laser on Sapphire-Si Bonded Substrate
abstract: An InP-based membrane laser is transfer-printed onto a thin sapphire on a Si substrate. Thanks to the low refractive index and high thermal conductivity of the sapphire, the fabricated laser has a 3-dB bandwidth of 26 GHz and performs 53.125-Gbit/s operations at 50 degrees Celsius.

articleTitle: SiN Photonic Integrated Circuit for Pump Laser Suppressed Nonlinear Signal Generations
abstract: We have proposed a SiN photonic integrated circuit for efficient pump suppressed nonlinear signal generations at λ ∼1550 nm. Fabricated devices exhibit four wave mixing process with an on-chip pump suppression upto 65dB. The proposed circuit can be potentially used for on-chip photonic qubit generations.

articleTitle: Numerical study on thickness-dependent crosstalk optimization in Germanium-on-Insulator platform
abstract: Germanium-on-Insulator(GOI) is an emerging integrated photonic platform for infrared applications like gas sensing. Here, we numerically explore the effect of anisotropic metamaterials for reducing the crosstalk between two coupled waveguides on a GOI platform.

articleTitle: A polarization-diverse coarse wavelength-division multiplexing silicon photonic receiver
abstract: We demonstrate a polarization-diverse coarse wavelength-division multiplexing (CWDM) silicon photonic receiver for co-packaged optics. Furthermore, we confirm that the polarization-dependent loss is compensated by using variable optical attenuators. Our all-in-one photonic integrated circuit exhibits a high shoreline bandwidth density of 266 Gbps/mm.

articleTitle: All-optical Silicon Photonics-based Logic Gate
abstract: We present an integrated photonics-based logic gate concept that combines coherent data encoding and micro-resonator-enhanced saturable absorption, enabling logic circuits to store and process data while in the optical domain. A phase-controlled "power rail" provides gate fanout and cascadability, with projected gate densities of ~5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Hybrid Integration of Thin-film Lithium Niobate and Silicon Photonics
abstract: Hybrid thin-film lithium niobate Mach-Zehnder electro-optic modulators can be incorporated within silicon and silicon nitride photonic circuits for improved performance in both classical and quantum photonics, and provide high-performance electro-optic modulation capability over extended wavelengths.

articleTitle: Few-GHz repetition rate frequency combs in IIIV/SiN external cavity lasers
abstract: We study the dynamics of hybrid integrated lasers with dispersive effective reflectivity implemented through coupled microrings in a SiN platform. We investigate the self-generation of optical frequency combs and characterize them in terms of bandwidth, spectral line separation, phase and amplitude noise.

articleTitle: Data Throughput for Efficient Photonic Neural Network Accelerators
abstract: Machine Learning has become a dominant technology, spurring the invention of photonic systems to implement neural network tasks. These photonic systems offer high throughput operations with low power but require large bandwidths of data to operate with maximum efficiency. Here we provide an analysis of the required data bandwidths, reaching nearly 1 Tbps for a single chip and necessitating the use of high bandwidth memory.

articleTitle: 2D NL model and design of SISCAP microring resonator with complex waveguide cross-section
abstract: We design silicon and polysilicon microring resonators with different cross-sections to minimise the nonlinear effects and self-heating in the SISCAP platform. We show that free carrier diffusion in rib waveguides reduces the impact of non-linearities resulting in high Q-factor and low free carriers lifetime.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of silicon optical antennas
abstract: We present a compact silicon-based surface grating antenna featuring an aperture size of less than 5 µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> which has a measured wide far-field beam width of 44°×52°. The antenna is based on a single-etch grating and a Bragg reflector on a 300-nm-thick silicon-on-insulator (SOI) platform.

articleTitle: High-performance integrated spectrometer with broad operation temperature range
abstract: We present a computational single-shot spectrometer fully integrated on silicon photonics platform. Enabled by novel broadband filters, it has a bandwidth of 100nm and a spectral resolution of 0.1nm, with a footprint around 3mm2. Moreover, it can work within 10-70 degrees Celsius without power consumption.

articleTitle: Alternative fabrication method for Ge-fin photodiodes with 3-dB bandwidths exceeding 110 GHz
abstract: We present results of an alternative method for the fabrication of germanium fin photodiodes to facilitate their integration into PIC and ePIC platforms. Therefore, process complexity as well as thermal budget shall be reduced. The fabricated photodiodes exhibit 3-dB bandwidths in excess of 110 GHz.

articleTitle: Photonic Extreme Learning Machines Using Hexagonal Programmable Waveguide Meshes
abstract: We propose employing a hexagonal mesh as a Programmable Photonic Extreme Learning Machine. Input encoding, random matrix multiplication and nonlinearity are performed on-chip while trained digitally. Experimental validation is obtained on two classification tasks, the Iris and Banknote dataset, with >95% and >91% accuracy.

articleTitle: Coupling controlled photonic topological ring array
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a ring array that changes its topological phase under different coupling parameters. It could work partly as a topological insulator and partly as a topologically trivial array to ensure light go along the virtue boundary between these two bulks.

articleTitle: Precise waveguide loss extraction using 300-mm wafer-level OFDR for optical process control monitoring
abstract: The propagation loss for silicon waveguides extracted by wafer-level OFDR was verified by comparing it with the cutback method. As the results of evaluating for 256 waveguides with a width of 420-480 nm, the OFDR and cut-back methods found to provide almost the same loss with a correlation coefficient of 0.96, indicating the applicability of OFDR to manufacturing monitoring.

articleTitle: Silicon Ring Based Wavelength Division Multiplexing With an Ultra-wide Spectral Range of 6.4 THz
abstract: A novel MZ filter, taking half of a ring resonator as the arm length difference, is proposed to double the spectral range for ring-based WDM. This scheme is experimentally validated as a 16×400 GHz WDM filter utilizing rings with 3.2 THz FSR.

articleTitle: On-Chip Refractive Index Sensors Based on Plasmonic TiN Nanohole Arrays
abstract: On-chip refractive index sensors realized on the Si platform can address a wide range of applications. Here, we demonstrate the use of CMOS-compatible devices, which combine TiN nanohole arrays as sensors with Ge photodetectors as transducers, for the detection of bulk refractive index changes.

articleTitle: Effect of poling voltage on electro-optic response of epitaxial BaTiO3 on Si grown by sputtering
abstract: Optical-grade BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> has been epitaxially integrated on silicon wafers by off-axis sputtering. We find that for films with in-plane ferroelectric polarization, the as-grown domain structure results in an initially reduced effective electrooptic response that can be "woken up" by sufficient poling.

articleTitle: High-order Euler Adiabatic Microring Filters with Free-Spectral-Range of over 49nm
abstract: High-order coupled resonance optical waveguide filters with ultra-large free-spectral-ranges are demonstrated. We use novel width evolution functions to reduce the size of the filters. Third to tenth-order filters were experimentally confirmed to have low-loss and flat-top response for possible use in WDM communications.

articleTitle: Integrated SiGe electro-optical modulator based on PIN diode in the 5.5-10 µm wavelength range
abstract: This paper reports the experimental demonstration of the first PIN electro-optical modulator operating in a wide mid-IR wavelength range. Free carrier plasma dispersion effect is exploited in SiGe waveguides, showing high efficiency with extinction ratio up to 3 dB in depletion and 10 dB in injection schemes at 10 µm wavelength. High speed operation is demonstrated, reaching frequencies up to 1.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Monolithically Integrated 940 nm VCSELs on Bulk Ge Substrates
abstract: This work successfully developed an independent Ge-VCSEL epitaxy and fabrication technology route. This is the second successful Ge-VCSEL technology reported worldwide, and the first Ge-VCSEL technology with key details disclosed, including Ge substrate specification, transition layer structure and composition, and fabrication process etc. Compared with the GaAs counterparts, after epitaxy optimization, the Ge-VCSEL wafer has a 40% lower surface root-mean square roughness and 72% lower average bow-warp. Additionally, the Ge-VCSEL has a 10% lower threshold current density and a 19% higher maximum slope efficiency than the GaAs-VCSEL.

articleTitle: Multimode-Fiber Imaging Using a Wavelength-Scanned Integrated Optical Phased Array
abstract: We present a high spatial-resolution multimode fiber imaging system, using an integrated optical phased array with only 8 phase shifters. By scanning wavelengths in a 10 nm span, an equivalent spatial resolution of 1.75 μm is achieved in a field of view of 105 μm.

articleTitle: A Calibration Technique for Microring Modulator Thermal Controller
abstract: We propose a calibration technique for the thermal control unit of microring modulators, where the controller derives the average power corresponding to the maximum OMA, without the need for high-speed circuits or simulations. This is expected to improve the production yield from 36% to 83%.

articleTitle: High-Q Silicon Nitride Waveguide Resonators by Nanoimprint Lithography
abstract: We demonstrate the fabrication of waveguide resonators using nanoimprint technology. Silicon nitride resonators are realized by nanoimprinting lithography (NIL) with high-quality (Q) factors up to the order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>. Nearly-zero waveguide dispersion can be achieved with 30 dB extinction ratios of cavity resonances.

articleTitle: Overcoming the Limits of Integrated Photonics by van der Waals Materials
abstract: While the advance of electronic technology allowed to scale down integrated circuit elements by orders of magnitude, their photonic counterparts remain limited in size and density of placement by diffraction of light. Here we detail how these limits can be shifted by utilizing novel van der Waals (vdW) materials thanks to their unprecedented refractive indices and giant anisotropy.

articleTitle: Complex Electro-Optic Frequency-Response Characterization of a Si Ring Modulator
abstract: Electro-optical (E/O) frequency-response of a Si ring modulator (RM) is characterized both in the magnitude and the phase domain for RM-based coherent transmitter performance optimization. The RM’s complex E/O responses are measured with heterodyne coherent reception, and the measured results are confirmed with the simulated.

articleTitle: Real-time Automatic Wavelength Alignment for Silicon Photonic AMZI Filter by Running Reinforced Q-Learning in Microcontroller
abstract: Wavelength and temperature changes will cause functional failures for silicon photonic filters. Here we experimentally demonstrate automatic work wavelength alignment (function maintaining) for silicon AMZI filters against large variations in external wavelength and temperature by implementing reinforced Q-learning algorithm in microcontroller of only 8-KB memory.

articleTitle: Ge with > 200 ns carrier lifetime and 3.7% uniaxial tensile strain on glass
abstract: In this work, Ge thin films on glass were successfully prepared from bulk Ge with an anodic bonding and thinning process. A Ge microbridge with very high crystal quality on glass was demonstrated with a uniaxial tensile strain of 3.7%, promising for light-emitting applications.

articleTitle: Franz-Keldysh Effect in Lateral pin Photodetectors of Ge Strip on Si at C-, L- and U-Band Wavelengths
abstract: Spectral responsivity is measured for lateral pin photodetectors of a Ge strip on Si. The Franz-Keldysh effect under high reverse voltage significantly enhances the responsivity not only in the C and L bands (1.530–1.625 μm) but also in the U band (1.625–1.675 μm).

articleTitle: III-V-on-Si Membrane Distributed Reflector Lasers with Intermixed MQW DBRs
abstract: We demonstrate distributed reflector lasers based on a III-V/Si membrane platform. The threshold current is reduced by half of that of a detuned distributed feedback laser owing to the use of quantum-well intermixed distributed Bragg reflectors; the minimum threshold current is 0.88 mA.

articleTitle: Self-Referencing Silicon Micro-Racetrack Resonator for on-Chip Optical Frequency Reference
abstract: We propose a dual-polarization high-Q silicon micro-racetrack resonator for laser frequency stabilization. Based on dual-mode self-reference temperature measurement and photothermal feedback technology, the on-chip reference cavity temperature is stabilized within ± 15 µK, indicating that ± 100 kHz reference frequency stability is also achieved.

articleTitle: Thinfilm lithium niobate 3-dB power splitter with ultrabroadband bandwidth from 1.2 to 2 µm
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 3-dB power splitter based on adiabatic mode evolution using thin-film lithium niobate, with ultra-broadband operation bandwidth. The fabricated power splitter exhibits low insertion losses of 0.2 dB, 0.16 dB, and 0.53 dB for wavelengths at 1310, 1550, and 2000 nm, respectively.

articleTitle: Millimeter-long antennas for optical-phased arrays
abstract: We study the behavior of mm-long BIC-effect and dual-layer antennas for silicon photonics based optical phased-arrays (OPAs). The designed and fabricated antennas are simulated and characterized in terms of divergence and directivity in order to achieve precise scanning of the environment.

articleTitle: Wavelength Division Multiplexing with Polarization Rotation
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a passive polarization rotator with wavelength selective characteristics in an a-Si/SiN sandwich waveguide. We report for the first time simultaneous wavelength division multiplexing and polarization rotation in a passive platform.

articleTitle: Long-term photoreliability of electro-optic polymer for high optical power modulator
abstract: The photoreliability test of the EO polymer-based modulator was performed. In an oxygen-free system, the device exhibited excellent V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</inf> stability at 80<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">○</sup>C for over 2,000 hours under an optical density of 0.74 mW um<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>.

articleTitle: 192-channel silicon Reconfigurable Optical Add-Drop Multiplexer
abstract: We have designed and demonstrated a 192-channel silicon Reconfigurable Optical Add-Drop Multiplexer (ROADM) for multi-dimensional multiplexing systems. The proposed ROADM accommodates a total of 192 channels (6 modes and 32 wavelengths), and each of them supports 100 Gbps 16QAM signal transmission.

articleTitle: Micro-transfer printing of O-band InP-InGaAs photodiodes on a silicon nitride photonic platform
abstract: We present the heterogeneous integration of O-band InP-InGaAs photodiodes on a silicon nitride photonic platform using micro-transfer printing technology. The devices exhibit a responsivity of 0.9 A/W at 1310 nm with an applied bias voltage of -3 V.

articleTitle: High Brillouin Gain in Silicon Subwavelength Slot Waveguides
abstract: Stimulated Brillouin scattering has been exploited in silicon photonics to demonstrate several key functionalities. We harness subwavelength nanostructuration to tailor near-infrared photons and GHz phonons, achieving a strong overlap that results in a high Brillouin gain of 1.91×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> for a 4.68 GHz mechanical mode.

articleTitle: Enhanced broadband silicon waveguide crossing based on PSO-processed SWG cladding
abstract: We propose a broadband silicon waveguide crossing based on particle swarm optimization of the subwavelength grating lateral cladding. Our design exhibits insertion loss < 0.190 dB, crosstalk < -30.84 dB, and reflection < -26.15 dB in simulations over 415 nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Rapid wavelength measurements with a silicon photonic wavemeter
abstract: We demonstrate rapid wavelength measurements with response times under 200 ns using a silicon photonic wavemeter. With this new capability, we show tracking of a DFB laser’s wavelength during fast ramps and short bursts, for possible use in LiDAR, sensing, imaging, or optical communication applications.

articleTitle: A compact programmable silicon photonic circuit
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a programmable photonic circuit based on a 7-cell hexagonal waveguide mesh of coupled 2x2 Mach-Zehnder interferometer gates. The use of undercut heaters results in a compact circuit with a large free spectral range for interferometers and ring resonator filters.

articleTitle: Low-loss Non-volatile Phase Change Material on Silicon for Neuromorphic Photonics
abstract: We demonstrate a low-loss, non-volatile phase switching of antimony selenide on a silicon microring resonator. We present the feasibility of a controlled multi-state weight definition that is essential for neuromorphic applications. We also present material, electrical, and optical characteristics in comparsion with GST.

articleTitle: Chalcogenides Phase Change Materials for PICs
abstract: A "zero-change" platform for monolithic back-end-of-line integration of phase-change materials (PCM) in silicon photonics was proposed and high performance nonvolatile PCM/Si heterogeneous integrated devices based on Sb2Se3 and Ge2Sb2Se4Te1 were demonstrated.

articleTitle: On the dynamic and static extinction ratio of germanium electro-absorption modulators
abstract: We compare dynamic and static extinction ratios of germanium electro-absorption modulators (EAM) and their dependency on optical power. We discuss that the common figure of merit, the quotient of static extinction ratio and insertion loss, may be inappropriate to evaluate EAMs without considering optical power.

articleTitle: 170 Gbaud On-Off-Keying SiP Ring Resonator Modulator-based Link for Short-Reach Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a record 170 Gbaud on-off keying C-band silicon photonics ring resonator modulator-based transmitter with performance below the 6.7% overhead HD-FEC threshold after optical back-to-back and transmission over 100 meters of single mode fiber.

articleTitle: Grating-assisted codirectional couplers for hybrid integration of active III-V on a normal SOI platform
abstract: Feasibility of enhancing the energy transfer between active III-V waveguide and normal SOI waveguide for hybrid integration is verified using grating-assisted codirectional couplers (GACC). High coupling efficiency can be obtained by adding a GACC structure to compensate the phase mismatching between two highly asynchronous waveguides.

articleTitle: Second-Harmonic-Wave Assisted Octave-Spanning Supercontinuum Generation in an AlGaAs-on-Insulator Waveguide
abstract: We have successfully generated a supercontinuum light in an AlGaAs-on-insulator waveguide. By using a 2000-nm-band pulse source and utilizing second-harmonic generation, we achieved a more than 1.2-octave bandwidth from 881 to 2149 nm.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Efficient Si Fiber Copuler with a Meta Structure of 150 nm Minimum Feature Size
abstract: We have proposed and designed a Si photonics grating coupler for >85% fiber coupling. In this study, we fabricated it with the smallest feature size of 150nm and confirmed the expected light output.

articleTitle: Optical Beam Steering of 16x64 Optical Phased Arrays with Small-range Tunable Lasers
abstract: Large-scale integrated 16x64 silicon photonics optical phased arrays (OPAs) are demonstrated to provide 40 degrees of steering angle with a <20-nm wavelength tunable laser and 1x16 optical switches. The design allows less control circuitry, simplified phase error correction, and relaxed requirements on integrated tunable lasers.

articleTitle: Optically-Pumped Lasing in GeSn Slab Waveguide on Silicon
abstract: We present an optically-pumped GeSn slab waveguide laser directly integrated on silicon substrates. Our laser design uses a Si ridge structure on the GeSn active layer to support guiding modes and achieve excel optical confinement. Lasing action was achieved under optical pumping up to T=90 K with an emission wavelength of 2254 nm and a threshold of 170 kW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Phase Shifter for Silicon Nitride Photonics using MEMS-Enabled Movable Cladding
abstract: We present a new type of out-of-plane MEMS phase shifter for silicon nitride photonic circuits. Compactness and very low power consumption of the device in combination with low optical loss are achieved by an actuated movable silicon dioxide cladding.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Quantum Random Number Generation in Silicon Nitride Microresonators
abstract: An all-optical quantum random number generator using a degenerate optical parametric oscillator based on silicon nitride is numerically investigated. A phase-sensitive gain with an extinction ratio of 20 dB is obtained for the bi-phase state. Furthermore, a generation rate of over 10 MHz is achieved.

articleTitle: Design on polarization-independent Germanium-on-Insulator Bragg filter
abstract: We design a polarization-independent Bragg filter on a Ge-on-Insulator platform that is free from input polarization status, achieving the same spectral responses for TE and TM inputs. Our Bragg filter operates near the 4.2 μm wavelength range, which is useful for mid-infrared sensing applications.
